chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shazaan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rabi', from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The perfection, every perfection is in three (matters), and he mentioned regarding the third, being the management of the livelihood.
ai.seo_question: What are the three matters that constitute complete perfection according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies financial prudence as a pillar of spiritual perfection, linking material management to divine decree (*al-taqdir*). This reflects the Shia scholarly view that worldly affairs, when handled with intentionality, are integral to the path of *kamil* (the perfected believer). The hadith underscores that managing one's livelihood is not merely a practical necessity but a spiritual discipline that complements worship.
